answer: A Registered domain bound by attestation certificate with revocation on transfer ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the registered domain answers a fresh challenge, the attestation certificate is recorded, and revocation on transfer keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A pearl that appears twice is the tell: the same channel cannot back two identities. A oasis alone is noise; a onyx of verified channels is a pattern the network can trust.
